## Code Example

```yaml
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Resources:
  TenantLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/tenant/${TenantId}/logs'
      RetentionInDays: 90
  TenantPublishRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${TenantId}-LogPublish'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
        - Effect: Allow
          Principal:
            AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${TenantAccountId}:root'
          Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      Policies:
      - PolicyName: LogPublish
        PolicyDocument:
          Version: '2012-10-17'
          Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action: 'logs:PutLogEvents'
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:logs:*:${CentralLoggingAccountId}:log-group:/aws/tenant/${TenantId}/*'
```

```javascript
// Node.js (AWS SDK) outline for rotating tenant certs
const { SecretsManagerClient, PutSecretValueCommand } = require('@aws-sdk/client-secrets-manager');
async function rotateTenantCert(tenantId, certPem, keyPem) {
  const client = new SecretsManagerClient({ region: 'us-east-1' });

}
```
